name: ponzu
description: Ponzu's canvases for your own agent: join a canvas, draw on it yourself, and steer with comments. Sign in with your Ponzu account.

interface.shortDescription: Canvases in the cloud, for your agent
interface.longDescription: Ponzu keeps canvases in the cloud, each beside a repository. From your agent, start a canvas and work on it yourself with Ponzu's tools while people comment. Then build what was settled in your own checkout, show the pull request on a board that keeps itself current, and settle the canvas once its work has landed. Sign in with your Ponzu account when your agent first connects.
defaultPrompt: Start a Ponzu canvas for a new onboarding flow and give me three takes
Bring this screen into a Ponzu canvas so we can redesign it
Watch my comments on the Ponzu canvas
